verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Synctera's sponsor-bank model — it explicitly connects founders with partner banks and provides collaboration tools 'between you and your bank partner' (synctera-docs-16, synctera-docs-17), making clear it is middleware rather than a chartered bank itself. However, there is no evidence addressing what happens to customer funds/accounts if Synctera itself fails or is wound down, which is a core part of this story. Missing for 10: explicit disclosure of failure/wind-down protections for end customers, clarity on which specific bank charter backs a given program, and any independent/regulatory confirmation of the sponsor relationship.
